title: vaccinium dunnianum
intro: Vaccinium dunnianum, commonly known as the Dunn's Evergreen Blueberry or Chinese Blueberry, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium dunnianum include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exert anti-cancer effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Vaccinium dunnianum contribute to its potential therapeutic uses and contribute to its traditional use in Chinese medicine.
